changes: A3a/A3b/A4: removed seed-1337/2024 robustness cells (FT seed s vs clarify seed 42 confounds seed with treatment). Plan-level note added: 'Clarify-trained arms exist at seed 42 only; A3 and A4 have no seed-robustness check.' Carried into significance.md as a limitation.

A5: effect size changed from odds ratio to risk difference in safe handling (hybrid minus model-only) with paired-bootstrap 95% CI; McNemar exact on b retained. In-sample caveat attached to A5 and to every detector mention in significance.md; detector rules and the test categories that informed each go in an appendix.
B8: Jonckheere-Terpstra dropped; Spearman rho is the only B8 test.
B1 kept as a Holm family of 2.

Operationalisation recorded (no change to the tests): correct_0p1 on the 146 numeric rows = em_0p1 for single-crop rows where a depth was extracted; multi_all_correct (all gold values within 0.1 mm) for the 30 multi-crop rows; 0 when no depth was extracted. Both use the 0.1 mm tolerance from s6_eval.score_row.

A5: demoted from PRIMARY to DESCRIPTIVE and removed from Holm (validity finding, not results-driven): the detector runs only on rows whose GOLD qtype is clarify and one rule reads the GOLD category, so it cannot produce a false positive or a c-cell by construction; McNemar is not a meaningful test. Risk difference + paired-bootstrap CI reported descriptively with the label: 'Oracle-gated diagnostic. The detector reads gold labels, runs only on known-incomplete queries, and its rules were written with the test categories in view. This is an upper bound on what surface rules can catch, not a performance estimate.' PRIMARY count at seed 42 falls from 32 to 31.

Exact-match denominators made explicit (no test changed): Two exact-match denominators are in use and are named wherever either figure appears: Stage 8 correct_0p1 = all 146 numeric rows (multi-crop rows counted correct only if every gold value is within 0.1 mm; rows with no extracted depth counted wrong); Stage 6 headline exact_0.1 = the 116 single-crop rows. No test was changed; both are tabulated per arm.

New DESCRIPTIVE family LANG (response language), exploratory: Exploratory descriptive added after Part A (plan v3), motivated by the A7 marker finding that zero-shot answers to Bengali questions were written in English. Response language is classified by script: bn if >= 50% of alphabetic characters are in the Bengali block (U+0980-U+09FF), else en. No test, no Holm.

Report-only: A7 reports registered primary (a) first, then sensitivity (b) as the definition matching the thesis; per-model zero-shot baselines reported prominently. A6 factual Llama: registered Wilcoxon verdict stands; bootstrap CI of the mean difference noted with skew. A6 numeric: CIs too wide to rule out ~15-point gaps. diff_unit column added to results CSVs so rate differences (pp) and metric-point differences are not confused.

a3_a4_seed_note: Clarify-trained arms exist at seed 42 only; A3 and A4 have no seed-robustness check.
a5_in_sample_caveat: Oracle-gated diagnostic. The detector reads gold labels, runs only on known-incomplete queries, and its rules were written with the test categories in view. This is an upper bound on what surface rules can catch, not a performance estimate.
correct_0p1_definition: correct_0p1 on the 146 numeric rows = em_0p1 for single-crop rows where a depth was extracted; multi_all_correct (all gold values within 0.1 mm) for the 30 multi-crop rows; 0 when no depth was extracted. Both use the 0.1 mm tolerance from s6_eval.score_row.
em_denominator_note: Two exact-match denominators are in use and are named wherever either figure appears: Stage 8 correct_0p1 = all 146 numeric rows (multi-crop rows counted correct only if every gold value is within 0.1 mm; rows with no extracted depth counted wrong); Stage 6 headline exact_0.1 = the 116 single-crop rows. No test was changed; both are tabulated per arm.
response_language_note: Exploratory descriptive added after Part A (plan v3), motivated by the A7 marker finding that zero-shot answers to Bengali questions were written in English. Response language is classified by script: bn if >= 50% of alphabetic characters are in the Bengali block (U+0980-U+09FF), else en. No test, no Holm.
scope: Scope: 362 of 422 test rows scored. The 60 rows needing human-authored golds (40 out_of_domain, 20 conflicting_values) are excluded from this thesis by design. The human evaluation sample additionally contains 18 authored Bengali translations of English test items, created to form bn/en pairs; results are reported with and without them.
seed_policy: primary = seed 42 (matches human eval and all clarify-trained arms). Every FT-involving automatic test that has a like-for-like FT arm at seeds 1337 and 2024 (A1, A2, A6, A7) is repeated on those seeds. A claim is 'robust' only if significant after Holm on all three seeds. Clarify-trained arms exist at seed 42 only; A3 and A4 have no seed-robustness check.
multiple_comparisons: Holm-Bonferroni across PRIMARY tests within each holm_family. SECONDARY and SENSITIVITY report raw p only. DESCRIPTIVE report bootstrap 95% CIs, no p.

human_sample_rule.exception: B5 uses all 200 (pairs need the authored translations); sensitivity = 82 native pairs

a7_definition: confident_error = 1 iff (a) s6_eval.classify_response(generation) == 'answer' AND (b) not truncated: generated tokens (re-tokenised with the model's own tokenizer; no finish_reason stored) < 511 AND (c) net_extracted == 1
a7_note: Definition motivated by Stage 6 observations (zero-shot hitting the 512-token cap); confirmatory of an observed pattern, not a blind prediction.
b4_method: Python statsmodels fallback (Rscript not on PATH; R not installed system-wide by policy)
verdict_wording: Non-significant results are reported as 'no significant difference detected' with the CI of the difference; never 'equivalent' or 'no difference'.
